protocol.frames: Exact displayed video frames; same raw frame for all methods
protocol.rgb: RGB [0,1]; bilinear downsampling when needed; PSNR and SSIM over full image; LPIPS AlexNet
protocol.depth: Millimeters; GT TIFF / 655.35; GaussianSLAM x1000; MonoGS x saved Sim3 scale x1000; nearest resizing; valid positive finite GT mask; invalid prediction set to zero; no visualization clipping
protocol.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-frame metrics; supplementary video diagnostics, not the main-table evaluation
